## What is the DESCRIPTION file? {.size-sm}

It is a structured text file that **centralizes** project **metadata** and 
**dependencies**, providing a clear overview of what a project is about and 
what it needs to run.

[]{.vspace-xs}

::: {.grid .text-center}

::: {.g-col-6}
[{{< fa file-lines size=xl >}}]{style="color: #0D657D;"}

[**Metadata**]{style="color: #0D657D;"}<br>
[Title, description, authors, license, URL, ...]{.size-sm}
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
[{{< fa cubes size=xl >}}]{style="color: #805A35;"}

[**Dependencies**]{style="color: #805A35;"}<br>
[External packages used in the project]{.size-sm}
:::

:::


[]{.vspace-xs}

{{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; Originally designed for R packages, it can also be used in a **research compendium**.



## Adding a DESCRIPTION file {.size-sm}


- It must be placed at the **root of the project**

- Its filename has **no file extension**

- Its filename must be written in **uppercase**

. . .

[]{.vspace-xs}

::: {.width-75}
::: {.callout-tip}
## The `{usethis}` package

To create a **DESCRIPTION** file in your project, try the `use_description()` function of 
the `{usethis}` package.

[]{.vspace-2xs}

::: {.width-33}
```{.r}
usethis::use_description()
```
:::

For more information [{{< fa up-right-from-square size=sm >}}](https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_description.html)


:::
:::


## Anatomy of the DESCRIPTION file {.size-sm}

[]{.vspace-lg}

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
```{.yaml}
Package: projectname
Type: Package
Title: The Title of the Project
Version: 1.0.0
Authors@R: c(
    person(
      given  = "Jane", 
      family = "Doe", 
      role   = c("cre", "aut", "cph"),
      email  = "jane.doe@mail.me"))
Description: A paragraph providing a full 
    description of the project.
License: GPL (>= 2)
URL: https://github.com/jdoe/projectname/
Depends: 
    ggplot2
Imports:
    dplyr,
    readr
Encoding: UTF-8
Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)
Config/roxygen2/version: 8.0.0
```
:::
:::

## Why avoid library()? {.size-sm}

Two issues with attaching packages w/ `library()`

[]{.vspace-xs}

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6 .fragment}
1. **Function origin is unclear**

```{.r}
library(foo)


bar()
```

::: {.size-sm}
- Where does `bar()` come from?
- Its package of origin is not explicit in the code
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .fragment}
2. **Function name conflicts**

```{.r}
library(foo)
library(baz)

bar()
```

::: {.size-sm}
- What if both packages provide a `bar()` function?
- The last attached package masks the other one
:::
:::

:::

[]{.vspace-sm}

. . .

```{.r}
library("tidyverse")   
## ── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ## ──
## ✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
## ✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()
## ℹ Use the conflicted package to force all conflicts to become errors
```

## Prefer the syntax foo::bar() {.size-sm}

Make function calls explicit w/ the [**Double Colon operator**](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/base/html/ns-dblcolon.html)

[]{.vspace-2xs}

::: {.width-33}
```{.r}
foo::bar()
baz::bar()
```
:::

. . .

[]{.vspace-2xs}

**Beneficits**

- **Clarity**: immediately identifies the package providing the function
- **No ambiguity**: avoids conflicts between functions with the same name
- **Maintainability**: makes code easier to read, understand and reuse

. . .

[]{.vspace-2xs}

::: {.width-75 .center}
::: {.callout-tip}
## Recommendation

{{< fa circle-info size=sm >}}&nbsp; Always use the syntax **`foo::bar()`** in your code[^funcall]
and do not use `library(foo)` anymore.
:::
:::

[^funcall]: Except if you call many functions of a package many times (e.g. `ggplot2`)


## Declaring dependencies in DESCRIPTION {.size-sm}

::: {.grid .g-gap-4}

::: {.g-col-6}

```{.yaml code-line-numbers="15-19"}
Package: projectname
Type: Package
Title: The Title of the Project
Version: 1.0.0
Authors@R: c(
    person(
      given  = "Jane", 
      family = "Doe", 
      role   = c("cre", "aut", "cph"),
      email  = "jane.doe@mail.me"))
Description: A paragraph providing a full 
    description of the project.
License: GPL (>= 2)
URL: https://github.com/jdoe/projectname/
Depends: 
    ggplot2
Imports:
    dplyr,
    readr
Encoding: UTF-8
Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)
Config/roxygen2/version: 8.0.0
```
:::


::: {.g-col-6 .size-sm .fragment}
[**Depends**]{.bg-tip}

- Packages **attached** when your project is loaded
- Their exported functions become available
- **Use it occasionally**!

. . .

[**Imports**]{.bg-tip style="margin-top: 1em;"}

- Packages are loaded but **not attached**
- Their functions can be called explicitly using `foo::bar()`
- **Prefer this field**!

[]{.vspace-sm}

::: {.callout-tip .fragment}
## Recommendation

{{< fa circle-info size=sm >}}&nbsp; Always list your packages in the **Imports** 
field and use the syntax **`foo::bar()`** in your code.
:::
:::

:::


## From DESCRIPTION to a reproducible workflow {.size-sm}

**Where are we?**

- We have implemented functions in the **R/** directory
- We have described our project in the **DESCRIPTION** file
- We have centralized dependencies in **Imports** (and occasionally in **Depends**)

. . .

[]{.vspace-xs}

{{< fa circle-info size=sm >}}&nbsp; We can now use **R package development tools** to manage our project

. . .

[]{.vspace-sm}

::: {.grid .text-center}

::: {.g-col-6}
[Install dependencies]{.bg-tip}

::: {.width-100 .size-lg}
```{.r}
pak::local_install_deps()
```
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
[Load project]{.bg-tip}

::: {.width-100 .size-lg}

```{.r}
devtools::load_all()
```
:::
:::

:::




## Install dependencies {.size-sm}

Use the **`local_install_deps()`** function of the **`{pak}`** package to 
install all packages listed in the **DESCRIPTION** file

. . .

This:

1. will read package names from the **DESCRIPTION** file (**Depends** & **Imports**)
2. will install all missing required packages
3. will update installed packages (unless `upgrade = FALSE`)
4. won't reinstall already installed packages

. . .

::: {.grid .g-gap-4}

::: {.g-col-6}

**Usage**


```{.r}
pak::local_install_deps()
```

[]{.vspace-sm}

::: {.size-sm}
{{< fa circle-info size=sm >}}&nbsp; For more information 
[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=sm >}}](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/local_install_deps.html)
:::

:::

::: {.g-col-6}

::: {.callout-tip .fragment style="margin-top: 4em;"}
## Recommendation

Don't use the `install.packages()` function anymore!
:::

:::
:::


## Load project {.size-sm}

Use the **`load_all()`** function of the **`{devtools}`** package to load the project


. . .

This:

1. will load packages listed in the **Imports** field of the **DESCRIPTION** file
2. will load & attach packages listed in the **Depends** field of the **DESCRIPTION** file
3. will "source" all functions in the **R/** directory

::: {.grid .g-gap-4}

::: {.g-col-6}

. . .

**Usage**


```{.r}
devtools::load_all()
```

[]{.vspace-sm}

::: {.size-sm}
{{< fa circle-info size=sm >}}&nbsp; For more information 
[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=sm >}}](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/load_all.html)
:::

:::

::: {.g-col-6}

::: {.callout-tip .fragment style="margin-top: 4em;"}
## Recommendation

- Don't use the `library()` function anymore!<br>
- Don't use the `source()` function anymore!
:::

:::
:::

## Wrap-up {.size-sm}

::: {.grid .size-sm}

::: {.g-col-6}

::: {.text-center}
[DO]{.bg-tip}
:::

[]{.vspace-xs}

- Add a **DESCRIPTION** file to your project
- List your packages in this file (**Imports**)
- Use the syntax **`foo::bar()`**
- Use **`pak::install_local_deps()`** to install required packages
- Use **`devtools::load_all()`** to load the project
:::


::: {.g-col-6}
::: {.text-center}
[DON'T]{.bg-tip}
:::

[]{.vspace-xs}

- Don't use **`install.packages()`**
- Don't use **`library()`** (use **`::`** or **Depends**)
- Don't use **`source()`** to source functions

:::

:::
